data.narrative:
Artimus Robotics is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Acome, Shane Mitchell, Nick Kellaris, and Christoph Keplinger. The company has raised $5M+ to date. The comparable universe consists of 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable method given data constraints. Using the $5M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $12M. The peer-median method could not be reliably applied; while 10 same-sector robotics peers exist in the dataset, insufficient clustering within narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier) prevented confidence in a comparable median.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, centered at $12M. This range reflects one-method triangulation with ±15% bounds. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific subsector and founding team caliber, and the absence of recent transaction data or detailed comparable multiples from the private peer set. Revenue, profitability, and runway visibility would materially refine this estimate.
